create temp view x as select 1;
with q as (select l.person_key p,l.history_id h,l.issue_key i,i.project_key pr,l.seconds s from model.logged_time l join model.issue i using(issue_key) where l.seconds>0 and l.logged_at>='2009-07-01+00' and l.logged_at<'2009-10-01+00'),
e as (select p,sum(s) v from q group by p having count(distinct pr)>=2),
r as (select p,v,rank() over(order by v desc) k from e)
select p as id, v as value, k from r where k<=5 order by v desc

e as (select p,sum(s) v from q group by p having count(distinct pr)>=2),

select q.p as id, r.v as value, q.h, q.i, q.pr from r join q on q.p=r.p where k<=5 order by v desc, id
